company_name: Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited

equity_bridge.item: Investments accounted for using the equity method + FVOCI financial asset, at book (30 Jun 2026)
equity_bridge.note: HK$40.9m associates/JVs + HK$6.5m FVOCI; their share of results (-8.7m FY2025, -3.5m H1 FY2026) is excluded from the EBITDA-based flows, so the asset enters the bridge once (matching-asset rule).
Flows are 100% consolidated; NCI (4.7% of FY2025 profit) charged once here, not in the flows.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case mid-horizon growth (FY2028-FY2035 path 2-3%), equal to terminal growth. Equity CAGR (5.1-6.8%) is rejected as the growth proxy because it measures retained earnings accumulating on a shrinking profit base (dividend payout < 100%), not business growth; revenue and EPS CAGRs are negative over 3 years.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+5.1% 3yr / +6.8% 5yr) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (-4.4% / +2.8%) and EPS (-15.2% / -6.3%). Owner-FCF CAGRs (+16.8% / +68.8%) are meaningless: the series runs 52.3 (FY2020), 698.5, 448.2, 374.5, -330.7 (FY2024 inventory build), 714.6 (FY2025 inventory release) and the endpoints are working-capital noise. The 5-year average owner FCF of HK$381m (24% of average revenue) is the usable anchor, and it is what the component build converges to.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF (OCF - capex) - lease principal - lease interest; SBC zero throughout; interest received is in investing under HKFRS and so is already outside reported FCF. Revenue history (HK$m): FY2020 1,315.3; FY2021 1,556.2; FY2022 1,731.1 (peak); FY2023 1,524.9; FY2024 1,611.6; FY2025 1,513.4; H1 FY2026 601.9 (-21.0% YoY). Gross margin 72.4% (FY2020) -> 61.2% (FY2025) -> 63.9% (H1 FY2026). IFRS-16 EBITDA margin 56.8% (FY2020) -> 54.5% -> 51.2% -> 46.3% -> 41.3% -> 37.7% (FY2025; 41.8% ex the HK$61.6m receivables impairment) -> ~40.9% H1 FY2026 ex the +17.0m impairment reversal.

scenario_narratives.base: The FY2026 revenue collapse (-21% in H1) is mostly self-inflicted - management tightened wholesale distribution to restore terminal price control and brand image after a year in which distributor receivables went bad (HK$102.8m in default, HK$61.6m impairment). The reset laps in FY2027, after which a 357-year-old brand with 63-64% gross margins, growing mainland and ASEAN channels and no debt grows at HKD inflation. Margin recovers to 42% EBITDA (post-IFRS-16) as the impairment does not repeat and raw-material inflation eases, but the 70%+ gross-margin era does not return. Value is roughly 35% net cash, 65% operating business at a 14x terminal multiple.
scenario_narratives.bull: The axes that move this stock up are (1) Hong Kong wholesale stabilising at a smaller, cleaner base while retail and clinics grow, (2) gross margin returning toward the mid-60s as bezoar/antelope-horn/deer input costs fall from the 2024 peak, (3) overseas registrations (Vietnam GMP, ASEAN, Gulf, Russia MOU) and the mainland distributor cap rising to HK$440m by 2028 delivering mid-single-digit growth, and (4) the market paying for a net-cash, 7% yielding heritage brand. All four are plausible; needing several at once is why the bull weight is below the house default.
scenario_narratives.bear: The axes that move it down are (1) the HK Chinese-medicine category shrinking structurally (-5.1% while total HK retail grew 9.6%), making the wholesale reset a permanent loss of volume rather than a pause, (2) distributor credit stress recurring (two customers now 56% of receivables), (3) counterfeiting and sibling-entity competition (1666.HK, 600085.SH) compressing Angong Niuhuang Wan pricing, and (4) raw-material inflation returning. Revenue falls a third and never recovers; the equity is then mostly cash plus a 12x multiple on ~HK$200m of FCF, and the dividend is cut.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating TCM business on a strict owner-FCF basis - leases charged as rent, NCI deducted, no SBC to adjust, interest income kept out of the flows - and add the HK$2.2bn of surplus cash once. The FY2025 reported FCF of HK$788m is a working-capital artefact; the business normalises at HK$370-400m before the FY2026 reset and the model builds from there. Risk is charged once: a 30% bear weight and a 14x terminal cap, not a stacked WACC premium. The market at HK$5.61 (EV/EBITDA ~4.4x FY2025, P/E 11.8x, 7.1% trailing yield) is pricing roughly the bear case; the question for an owner is whether the FY2026 decline is a reset or a trend.
key_risks_to_valuation: Revenue trajectory: the model assumes the -21% H1 FY2026 decline is mostly a deliberate wholesale reset that laps in FY2027; if HK category weakness is structural the bear path (-33% cumulative) applies and value falls to roughly the current price.

EBITDA margin recovery to 42% depends on the FY2025 receivables impairment not recurring and gross margin holding 63-64%; a return to FY2025's 61.2% gross margin with opex deleverage takes 4-5pp off the margin and ~HK$1/share off value.

Working-capital treatment: HK$1.25bn of inventory is held as operating, not surplus; a sustained inventory run-down would add cash the model does not credit, while another raw-material stockpiling cycle (FY2024) would take a year of FCF away.
Related-party and group-structure risk: distribution and procurement terms with Tong Ren Tang Ltd/Holdings are renewed every three years and are not priced explicitly beyond the bear weight.
Terminal multiple: 14x FCF cap on a business that has not grown since FY2022; the base value is ~50% terminal.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3613.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 5.40-9.50.
data_sources.financials: 3613.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2017-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026 interims, HK$ millions, derived from the HKEX annual and interim reports in Extracted/); H1 FY2026 interim report for the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet, cash-flow and expenses-by-nature lines; FY2025 annual report for the ten-year summary, segment D&A split and tax.
data_sources.qualitative: 3613.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22): business model, HK/mainland/overseas mix, receivables deterioration, channel-tightening commentary, bull/bear cases.

inputs.share_count_basis: 837,100,000 ordinary shares in issue; H1 FY2026 interim note 10 states 'there were no potential dilutive shares' (basic = diluted). No options, awards or convertibles. Held flat: no SBC, no buybacks, no issuance since listing.
inputs.cash_note: 30 Jun 2026: cash and cash equivalents HK$2,158.6m + short-term bank deposits with original maturity > 3 months HK$49.3m. Borrowings HK$0.107m (36 non-current + 71 current). Lease liabilities HK$125.7m EXCLUDED from net debt under lease treatment (B).
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 owner FCF = reported FCF 788.3 (OCF 829.5 - capex 41.2) - lease principal 68.1 - lease interest 5.7 = 714.6. SBC is zero. Interest income is NOT deducted here because HKFRS classifies interest received (HK$44.2m FY2025) in investing activities, so OCF and reported FCF already exclude it; the cash pile is credited once, in the bridge. WARNING: FY2025 owner FCF is inflated by roughly HK$340m of working-capital release (inventory ran down after the FY2024 stockpile that drove OCF to -217.3). The normalised component build (EBITDA 570.6 - lease 73.7 - D&A ex-ROU 25.3 = EBIT 471.6; less 18% tax; + D&A - capex) is ~HK$370-400m, and the year-1 projection lands there deliberately rather than carrying 714.6 forward.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 finance income HK$46.8m (H1 FY2026 HK$24.4m) sits below operating profit and is received in investing cash flows, so it is outside the EBITDA-based component build and outside reported FCF. Zero deduction is therefore the correct no-double-count treatment; the HK$2.2bn cash that earns it is added once via net_debt.
inputs.sbc_source: Annual reports FY2017-FY2025 and H1 FY2026 interim: no share option scheme, no share award scheme, no share-based payment expense in the expenses-by-nature note (SBC-zero market convention).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T08:08:34Z (16:08 HKT, after the 16:00 HKEX close - regular-session close)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are HKD; HKD is pegged to USD so the risk-free rate is the HK 10-year Exchange Fund Note / US 10-year (~3.8-4.2% in Oct 2026, use 4.0%). Equity risk premium 5.5% (mature-market 4.5% plus ~1pp for the Hong Kong/mainland China exposure of 73% of revenue). Beta 0.9: a defensive health-product/consumer-staple demand profile offset by small-cap illiquidity. Cost of equity = 4.0 + 0.9 x 5.5 = 8.95%, rounded to 9.0%. The company has no debt (gearing 3% is all leases), so WACC = cost of equity = 9.0%. NO additional premium is stacked for product concentration, HK channel risk, counterfeiting, related-party structure or regulatory change: those risks are charged once, in the flows, through a 30% bear weight (double the house default) and a 14x terminal cap (below the 20x house default). The same 9.0% applies to all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Full lease cash (principal in financing + interest in operating, both from the cash-flow statement: FY2025 68.1 + 5.7 = 73.7 = 4.9% of revenue; H1 FY2026 34.2 + 3.0 = 37.2 = 6.2% of the lower H1 revenue) is deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (HK$125.7m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. ebitda_margin_path is the post-IFRS-16 (pre-lease) EBITDA margin that reconciles to the CSV EBITDA series (FY2025: operating profit 472.2 + D&A 98.4 = 570.6). da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PPE 19.3 + intangibles 6.0 = 25.3 = 1.7%; H1 FY2026 13.0 = 2.2%), so the lease is charged once and cash tax is computed on a true post-rent EBIT. Short-term and variable lease expense (HK$6.8m H1 FY2026) is already inside the EBITDA margin.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests at book value HK$182.4m (30 Jun 2026) deducted via equity_bridge. Flows are modelled at 100% of the consolidated group. NCI took 4.7% of FY2025 profit (HK$19.6m) and 1.5% in H1 FY2026; at ~10x that share the book deduction is a fair proxy. Check: FY2025 modelled NOPAT ~HK$387m (EBIT 471.6 x 0.82) vs reported profit for the year 416.9 incl. HK$41.2m net finance income and -8.7m associate losses, i.e. ~384 ex those items - ties.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component engine (make build-dcf), scenario-weighted, 10-year explicit horizon. ROUTING: Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine is an operating company (TCM manufacturing at Tai Po, wholesale distribution, 76 retail outlets/clinics in HK and 17 overseas territories). It is not a holdco, REIT, LIC or financial; the HK$2.2bn cash is surplus to an operating business that generates HK$370-400m of normalised owner FCF, so the correct treatment is an operating DCF plus net cash in the bridge, not a NAV model. The net-cash/no-growth-capex profile was considered as an argument for a yield/capitalisation model instead; rejected because the flows are explicit and the question the DCF answers (what is the operating business worth after the deliberate FY2026 channel reset) is one a capitalisation would have to assume away. Non-US adaptations applied: lease treatment (B), NCI via bridge, SBC-zero (house = street, band_position null), interest-income/matching-asset rule (cash and the HK$47.4m associates+FVOCI stake in the bridge; their income outside the flows). CURRENCY: statements and quote both HKD (no FX bridge). INVENTORY: HK$1,254m of inventory (83% of FY2025 revenue - rare raw materials such as bezoar, antelope horn, deer products held at cost) is treated as operating working capital and NOT added to the bridge; it is a real buffer against raw-material inflation but is also why owner FCF swings +/-HK$300m year to year. wc_capture_pct is set NEGATIVE (-30%) because receivables + inventory far exceed payables: growth consumes cash, decline releases it (as FY2025 did). FY2026 anchor: no numeric guidance; H1 FY2026 revenue -21.0% (wholesale -27.8% on deliberate channel tightening, HK retail +5%), gross margin 63.9%. Year-1 growth of -17% (base) assumes H2 FY2026 falls ~12% as the tightening partially laps the H2 FY2025 base of HK$751.6m. DIVIDEND: FY2025 total DPS HK$0.40 (0.37 final + 0.03 special) = HK$334.8m paid in H1 FY2026, ~85-90% of normalised owner FCF; the 7.1% trailing yield is covered by cash flow and HK$2.2bn of cash, but not by a growing earnings base.

bear.rationale: The decline is structural, not a reset: H2 FY2026 matches H1 (-22% for the year), FY2027 -8% as HK wholesale keeps shrinking, the HK Chinese-medicine retail category keeps losing share of consumer spending, overseas distributors destock and counterfeits erode Angong Niuhuang Wan pricing. Revenue bottoms at ~HK$1.0bn (-33% from FY2025) and only inflation-grows thereafter. Gross margin drifts back to 60-61% on raw-material and mix pressure, opex deleverages, EBITDA margin settles at 35%; fixed rents push lease cost above 6% of revenue. Distributor credit losses recur. Terminal 1.0%, 12x cap. The HK$2.2bn cash and a sustained HK$0.30-0.35 dividend hold the equity up even here: the bear-case value is largely cash plus a 12x multiple on a smaller business.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -17%: H1 actual -21.0%; H2 modelled ~-12% against the H2 FY2025 base of HK$751.6m as the deliberate wholesale channel tightening (wholesale -27.8% in H1) partially laps. FY2027 -3%: the reset finishes lapping, HK retail (+5% H1 FY2026) and the mainland distributor channel (+18.3% FY2025, framework cap rising 230 -> 320 -> 440m over 2026-28) offset continued HK wholesale and category weakness (HK Chinese-drug retail sales -5.1%). FY2028-31 2-3%: low-single-digit recovery from ASEAN (Vietnam GMP), macro-health SKUs and store revitalisation, decelerating to 2.5% terminal, which is HKD inflation plus nothing - the business has not grown revenue since FY2022.
base.margin_rationale: IFRS-16 EBITDA margin 40.0% in FY2026 (H1 40.9% ex impairment reversal; H2 deleverages on lower revenue) recovering to 42.0% by FY2030: gross margin holds 63-64% (raw-material prices off their mid-2024 peak, mix shift to retail), opex ratio normalises as the FY2025 HK$61.6m receivables impairment does not repeat. 42% is 4pp below the FY2021-25 average (46.2%) and 12pp below FY2021 because the 70%+ gross margin era is not assumed to return. Lease cost 6.0% -> 5.0% as fixed rents are spread over a recovering revenue base. D&A ex-ROU ~2.0-2.1%, capex 2.3% (FY2021-25 average 2.1%), FY2026 capex 1.5% on the H1 run-rate of HK$2.6m. Cash tax 18%: HK 16.5% statutory blended with mainland 25% (FY2025 effective 17.4%, FY2024 16.0%).
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 9.0%/2.5% implies 15.8x terminal-year FCF; capped at 14x for a mature, ex-growth consumer-health franchise. The cap binds in the base case.

bull.rationale: Channel reset completes in FY2026 (-14%, H2 only -6%) and the brand-integrity strategy pays off: gross margin returns toward 66-67% as raw-material deflation feeds through and distribution is weighted to higher-margin retail/clinic sales; EBITDA margin recovers to 46% (the FY2021-25 average, still 8pp below FY2021). Revenue grows mid-single digits FY2028-30 on Vietnam/ASEAN registrations, the mainland distributor cap stepping up to HK$440m, macro-health SKUs and e-commerce. Terminal 3.0% and a 15x cap; WACC unchanged at 9.0% (risk is in the weights, not the rate).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: revenue has fallen in three of the last four years and is accelerating downward (-6.1% FY2025, -21.0% H1 FY2026), 62% of sales come from one structurally weak market (Hong Kong), management gives no numeric guidance, distributor credit quality deteriorated sharply in FY2025, and the brand/formula moat is shared with two sibling listed entities. Bull lowered from 35% to 20% because it requires several independent things to go right (HK stabilisation, margin recovery, overseas scale-up). Base 50%. No going-concern or covenant element: the balance sheet (HK$2.2bn cash, no debt) is why bear is 30% and not higher.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
